title: Filter bubbles and affective polarization in user-personalized large language model outputs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the language model with specific user political affiliations via system prompts (e.g., Democrat, Republican, or fine-grained ideological leanings), querying factual information about public political figures and media outlets, and evaluating the responses using sentiment analysis (DistilBERT) and qualitative review of fact inclusion/exclusion.
